name: Steel Coil
description: Upon use, immediately causes all allies to lose HP equal to 40% of their Max HP, and increases their Elation by 40% for the next battle.
story:
A 30-ton steel coil.
Due to a certain childhood trauma of moderate significance, a retail industry tycoon decided to use a special method to remind the residents of Planarcadia to pay attention to workplace and daily safety. Now, you can buy this type of steel coil at any convenience store in Planarcadia.

"That's not my rubber ducky. It's not that flat."
